prompt: Add a DynamoDB storage backend: which file defines the interface to implement, which existing file is the best template, which file selects/wires the backend at startup.

assertions.text: Names store/store.ts as defining the EventStore interface to implement
Identifies a store-* implementation (e.g. store-postgres.ts) as the template to copy
Identifies server.ts as where the backend is selected/wired at startup
